parsed.summary: The schematic matches the documented reference design on every point the specification calls out: the CAN crystals Y1/Y2 are 16 MHz (the corrected value, not 12 MHz), the CAN TVS arrays D9/D10 are CDSOT23-SM712, the USB ideal-diode controller U6 is an LTC4412xS6 with a P-ch MOSFET, the e-stop buffers U15/U22/U35/U36 are SN74LVC1G07 wired as /OE-controlled sinks for ESTOP_SINK1/SINK2/SINK_LOCAL feeding ESTOP_OUT shared with J2/J13, GLOBAL_EN is tied directly to SW1 with no sequencing IC, and the WS2812 chain and MCP2515 CAN controllers are present as described. The remaining open items (USB diode, GLOBAL_EN power-on delay, CAN LED polarity, C5 footprint, RTC as a mere datasheet link) are documented known issues/TODOs, not deviations, so no anomaly is reported.
